notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Glen Elendra Archmage does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage, adding {C}{C}.
Glen Elendra Archmage dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Glen Elendra Archmage enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting a +1/+1 counter on Glen Elendra Archmage.
Repeat.
